title: 第11章坊市，我来了
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
“恭喜啊，陈师兄。”

    外门弟子院的执事姓孙，四十来岁，圆脸，笑起来眼睛眯成一条缝，说话的时候脸上的肉一颤一颤的，把一块铜牌和一个小布袋推到桌上，布袋口没扎紧，能看见里面灰白色的灵石角。

    “月俸，五块下品灵石，二十颗辟谷丹，每月十五来领，过了十五当天不补。”

    陈青山接过来。灵石很小，指甲盖大小，灰白色，不透明，表面有一层细微的粉末，摸着温温的，像被太阳晒过的石头，里面有一丝灵气在缓缓流动。他把灵石倒在手心里数了数，五块，一块不多一块不少。

    第一份月俸。

    揣进怀里。又打开布袋看了看辟谷丹，圆溜溜的黑色药丸，装在一只小瓷瓶里，瓶口用蜡封着，闻起来有一股淡淡的药草味。二十颗。够了，以前在杂役房一个月才十五颗。

    他全掏出来加上之前攒的，拢共三十七块下品灵石。来到青云宗大半年，全部家当就这些。

    三十七块。搁前世，这点钱连顿火锅都吃不起。

    “住处呢？”

    “丁字号第七间，后山那排平房，最靠边那间，条件一般，但比杂役房强，至少有独立的门和窗，不用跟七八个人挤一屋。”

    “多谢孙师兄。”

    “客气什么。”孙执事笑了笑，眼睛又眯起来了，“你那拳，整个器峰都传遍了，我今天当值，好几个人跑来跟我打听你的事。”

    陈青山没接这话，抱了拳就走了。

    拿了东西出来，顺着山路往后山走，外门弟子院在器峰后半山腰，从杂役房那边走过去要翻一个小坡，路上经过几个杂役，看到陈青山腰间的铜牌愣了一下，有个年纪大的赶紧侧身让路，嘴里小声喊了句“陈师兄”。

    陈青山点了点头，没停。

    一排平房，灰砖青瓦，比杂役房强多了。丁七号，推门进去，一张床，一张桌，一把椅子，墙角石柜上落了一层灰，窗户木格糊着粗纸，纸发黄了，有个角翘起来。

    就这点家当，但门是自己的。

    没有打呼声，不对，隔壁就有，算了。

    陈青山把门关上，找了一块破布把灰擦了，桌子、椅子、石柜、窗台，都擦了一遍，擦完把东西放下，铜牌搁桌上看了一眼，收进怀里。

    还有一件事。

    ……

    废器房。

    陈青山到门口的时候，几个杂役正在搬废铁，一个个灰头土脸的，胳膊上沾满了铁锈，看到他那块铜牌愣了一下，有个年纪大的赶紧堆了笑：“陈……陈师兄？”以前同一个组的，一起搬过废铁，一起挨过铁三爷的骂。

    “我找小石头。”

    “小石头在后院分拣，我去叫他。”

    “不用，我自己去。”

    后院。

    小石头蹲在一堆废铁前面，手里拿着一块破布在擦铁片，身上那件灰布褂子脏得看不出原来的颜色，袖口磨出了毛边，领子上沾着铁锈和汗渍，他擦得很认真，每一块铁片都翻来覆去地擦，嘴角抿着，眉头微皱，像在做一件极其重要的事。

    陈青山站在门口看了一会儿。

    十五岁，瘦得像根柴火棍，胳膊细得能看到骨头，手指头上全是铁锈和老茧，指甲缝里嵌着洗不掉的黑泥，十三岁来的，两年了，没长高多少，光长了一双满是伤口的手。

    “小石头。”

    孩子抬头，愣了一下，然后眼睛亮了，像两颗石子掉进了水里，亮了一下。

    “青山哥！”

    他扔下破布就跑过来，跑到一半又停住，看了看陈青山腰间的铜牌，嘴张开了，半天没合上，然后他笑了，笑得眼睛都看不见了，脸上的灰被笑纹挤成了一道一道的。

    “你……你升外门了？”

    “嗯。”

    “太好了！青山哥太厉害了！”小石头蹦了一下，然后又赶紧收住，怕动静太大被别人看到，他压着声音，但压不住那种高兴劲儿，“我就知道，我就知道你肯定能出去的！”

    陈青山从布袋里掏出两颗辟谷丹和一小包零嘴，花生米和炒黄豆，用油纸包着的，是他在杂役房小卖处拿月俸换的，早就揣在怀里，专门留到今天。

    “拿着。”

    小石头接过去，低头看了看，又抬头看他，眼眶红了，泪水在眼眶里打转，但没掉下来。

    “青山哥，你吃了吗？”

    “我吃了，你拿着。”

    陈青山蹲下来，揉了一下他的脑袋，头发硬硬的，像枯草，大概很久没洗过了。

    “好好干，别跟人起冲突，铁三爷说什么你就听着，别，等我站稳了，想办法把你弄出来。”

    “嗯！”小石头使劲点头，拿袖子抹了一把眼睛，抹了一脸灰。
content_en:
"Congratulations, Senior Brother Chen."

    The deacon of the Outer Disciple Academy was named Sun. He was in his forties and had a round face. When he smiled, his eyes narrowed into slits. When he spoke, the flesh on his face trembled. He pushed a bronze medal and a small cloth bag onto the table. The mouth of the cloth bag was not tied tightly, and the gray-white spirit stone corners could be seen inside.

    "Monthly stipend, five low-grade spiritual stones and twenty Bigu Pills. Come and collect them on the 15th day of every month. After the 15th day, you will not be replenished on the same day."

    Chen Qingshan took it. The spirit stone is very small, about the size of a fingernail, off-white, opaque, with a layer of fine powder on the surface. It feels warm to the touch, like a stone that has been dried by the sun, with a trace of spiritual energy flowing slowly inside. He poured the spiritual stones into his hand and counted them, five pieces, no more than one and no less.

    The first monthly salary.

    Put it in your arms. Then he opened the bag and looked at Bigu Dan. It was a round black pill in a small porcelain bottle. The mouth of the bottle was sealed with wax. It smelled faintly of herbs. Twenty. That's enough. I used to get only fifteen pills a month in the service room.

    He took it all out and added what he had saved before, making a total of thirty-seven low-grade spiritual stones. After coming to Qingyun Sect for more than half a year, this is all I have.

    Thirty-seven dollars. In my previous life, I couldn't even afford a hot pot meal with this little money.

    "Where's your accommodation?"

    "The seventh room in the T-shaped room, in the row of bungalows in the back hill, is the one on the far side. The conditions are average, but it is better than the service room. At least it has independent doors and windows, so you don't have to share a room with seven or eight people."

    "Thank you, Senior Brother Sun."

    "You're welcome." Deacon Sun smiled and narrowed his eyes again, "Your punch spread throughout Qifeng. I was on duty today, and several people came to me to ask about you."

    Chen Qingshan didn't answer these words, hugged his fists and left.

    After taking the things out, I walked along the mountain road to the back mountain. The Outer Disciple Academy is halfway up the mountain behind Qi Peak. There is a small slope to climb from the side office. I passed several servants on the way and was stunned when I saw the bronze medal on Chen Qingshan's waist. An older man quickly turned sideways to give way and whispered "Senior Brother Chen".

    Chen Qingshan nodded without stopping.

    A row of bungalows with gray bricks and blue tiles, much better than utility rooms. Ding No. 7, pushed the door open and went in. There was a bed, a table, and a chair. There was a layer of dust on the stone cabinet in the corner. The wooden grid of the window was covered with coarse paper. The paper was yellowed and one corner was warped.

    It's just this little possessions, but the door is yours.

    There was no snoring, no, there was one next door, forget it.

    Chen Qingshan closed the door, found a rag and wiped the dust. He wiped the table, chairs, stone cabinets and window sills. After wiping, he put the things down, took a look at the bronze medal table and put it in his arms.

    One more thing.

    …

    Waste equipment room.

    When Chen Qingshan arrived at the door, several handymen were moving scrap iron. They were all gray-faced and covered with rust on their arms. They were stunned for a moment when they saw his bronze medal. An older man quickly smiled: "Chen...Senior Brother Chen?" We were in the same group in the past, we had moved scrap iron together, and we had been scolded by Third Master Tie together.

    "I'm looking for pebbles."

    "The pebbles are being sorted in the backyard. I'll call him."

    "No, I'll go by myself."

    backyard.

    Xiao Shitou squatted in front of a pile of scrap metal, holding a rag in his hand and wiping the iron pieces. The gray cloth coat on his body was so dirty that the original color could not be seen. The cuffs were frayed, and the collar was stained with rust and sweat. He wiped it carefully, turning over every piece of iron and wiping it over and over. The corners of his mouth were pursed and his brows were slightly furrowed, as if he was doing something extremely important.

    Chen Qingshan stood at the door and watched for a while.

    Fifteen years old, as thin as a matchstick, with arms so thin that you can see the bones, his fingers are covered with rust and calluses, and there is black mud embedded in the nails that cannot be washed away. He is thirteen years old, and he has not grown much in two years. He only has a pair of hands full of wounds.

    "Little stones."

    The child looked up, stunned for a moment, and then his eyes lit up, like two pebbles dropped into the water.

    "Brother Qingshan!"

    He threw down the rag and ran over. He stopped halfway and looked at the bronze medal on Chen Qingshan's waist. He opened his mouth and didn't close it for a long time. Then he laughed, so hard that his eyes couldn't see. The ash on his face was squeezed into lines by laugh lines.

    "You...you were promoted to an outer sect?"

    "Yeah."

    "Great! Brother Qingshan is so awesome!" Xiao Shitou jumped a little, and then quickly stopped it. He was afraid that the movement would be too loud and others would see it. He suppressed his voice, but he couldn't suppress his joy, "I knew it, I knew you would definitely be able to get out!"

    Chen Qingshan took out two Bigu Pills and a small bag of snacks, peanuts and fried soybeans from the cloth bag, wrapped in oil paper. He got them in exchange for his monthly salary at the commissary in the utility room. He had kept them in his arms for a long time and kept them until today.

    "Take it."

    Xiao Shitou took it, looked down, and then looked up at him. His eyes were red, and tears were rolling in his eyes, but they did not fall.

    "Brother Qingshan, have you eaten?"

    "I'll eat it, you take it."

    Chen Qingshan knelt down and rubbed his head. His hair was as stiff as dry grass. It had probably not been washed for a long time.

    "Work hard and don't conflict with others. Just listen to what Mr. Tie San says. No, wait until I stand firm and find a way to get you out."

    "Yeah!" Xiao Shitou nodded vigorously, wiped his eyes with his sleeve, and wiped the gray on his face.
